messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Help with Independent Records
parts:
Hello Marion,

don't worry, you came to the right place. And you already found out that this is done via camtrapR:::assessTemporalIndependence.

But first of all your table seems to contain both records and the camera trap information. This is redundant, since the coordiantes and dates will the identical for all records at the same stations. So the first thing I'd suggest is make two separate tables, one for the camera trap stations and one for the records. See ?camtraps and ?recordTableSample, or the vignettes of camtrapR.

Then, how do you want to take the number of animals into account? What would you like to do with that information when extracting independent events?

TO get the DateTimeOriginal column, it might be easiest to use

library(lubridate)

and then create a new date/time column with:

base$DateTimeOriginal <- dmy_HMS(paste(base$Photo.Date, base$Photo.Time))


I haven't tested this though.

Best regards,

Jürgen

Dear camtrapR Community,

 

I hope you are all doing well

I am new using camtrapR and I need your help... I don't have anywhere else to ask. I have a camera trapping data set which I would like to extract only the independent events from.  There´s a capture attached of my data. 

I need to extract independent records of each specie taken at 24 and 48 h per sampling unit. I tried the next code but I have errors when I run it because date and time are on different columns and there´s no DateTimeOriginal column and I have no idea how to create it: 

library(camtrapR)

base <- read.csv2 ("base.csv", header = TRUE)

head(base)

 

# filter records

 records_filter24_h <- camtrapR:::assessTemporalIndependence(intable = base,

                                                                 deltaTimeComparedTo = "lastIndependentRecord",

                                                                 columnOfInterest = "Species",

                                                                 stationCol = "Sampling.Unit.Name",

                                                                 minDeltaTime = 1440,

                                                                 camerasIndependent = FALSE )

 

I need to add that some photos have more than one individual on it (Number.of.Animals column) and i have no idea how to take this into accunt when extracting the independent events. I´d really appreciate your help.

 Sorry for my english

Thanks!

messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Help with Independent Records
parts:
Hi Marlon,

the table in the screenshot is a record table (with information about what species was detected when and where). But the function expects that CTtable should contain the information about camera traps. The table you provide also contains these (camera start/end /latitude / longiteude), but they are redundant, which causes there error.

See the example in

data(camtraps)

or

?surveyReport

or the vignette for examples of what it should look like.

Best regards,

Jürgen
